quantities.label: Detuning (true)
quantities.note: Resonance minus the declared line; + is red of the line.

quantities.label: Lock error
quantities.note: Detuning minus the lock reference.

quantities.label: |Lock error|
quantities.note: Size of the lock error; max is the tick extreme.

quantities.label: Ring temperature
quantities.note: The mode-weighted ring observer.

quantities.label: Absorbed light
quantities.note: Optical power absorbed in the ring, all lines; it heats the ring.

quantities.label: Light in on its line
quantities.note: Power of the declared line at the ring input.

quantities.label: relOMA
quantities.note: OMA / P_in at the through port. Mean: 10 log10 of the linear mean.

quantities.label: Oracle relOMA
quantities.note: The best stable relOMA at the same instant.

quantities.label: OMA lost to the oracle
quantities.note: Oracle relOMA minus relOMA, per 10 µs sample.

quantities.label: Heater code (register)
quantities.note: Latched DAC register; rails 0 and 65535.

quantities.label: Headroom to the nearest rail
quantities.note: The smaller of (code − low rail) and (high rail − code).

quantities.label: Heater voltage
quantities.note: Driver output voltage.

quantities.label: Heater current
quantities.note: I = V / R.

quantities.label: Heater resistance
quantities.note: Changes with the heater temperature (TCR).

quantities.label: Heater power
quantities.note: Electrical power into the heater.

quantities.label: Power left at full code
quantities.note: The driver law at full code and the present heater temperature, minus the power now.

quantities.label: Heater temperature
quantities.note: The heater-resistor observer.

quantities.label: Code step per controller step
quantities.note: |register change| from one controller step to the next.

quantities.label: Bank heater power
quantities.note: Sum of the 8 heaters (supply limit 200 mW).

quantities.label: Bank heater current
quantities.note: Sum of the 8 heater currents (supply limit 150 mA).

quantities.label: Drop power into the PD
quantities.note: All lines and orders, averaged over the data.

quantities.label: PD current (signal + dark)
quantities.note: The current that the ADC integrates.

quantities.label: Dark current
quantities.note: Grows with the PD temperature.

quantities.label: PD temperature
quantities.note: The PD thermal observer.

quantities.label: ADC code
quantities.note: Latest released code; full scale 65535. Min and max: tick extremes.

quantities.label: ADC headroom to full scale
quantities.note: Full scale minus the highest code in each 10 µs.

quantities.label: Light into the chip
quantities.note: Per laser line, after the chip input loss.

quantities.label: Laser output
quantities.note: Per laser line, at the laser module.

quantities.label: Frequency offset from the grid
quantities.note: Per laser line (0 in the nominal world).

quantities.label: Heater command
quantities.note: Controller output after the channel clip.

quantities.label: |Command − DAC code|
quantities.note: The DAC lags the command by its latency.

quantities.label: BER (instantaneous)
quantities.note: BER of the declared line from the bus-output OMA. Mean = the time mean (expected errors / bits).

quantities.label: OMA at the receiver
quantities.note: Bus-output OMA × 0.501 link transmission.

quantities.label: Extinction ratio
quantities.note: At the ring's through port.

quantities.label: Insertion loss
quantities.note: Of the high level at the through port.

quantities.label: Junction bias
quantities.note: Mean of the two NRZ levels.

quantities.label: Ones density
quantities.note: Fraction of ones in the data.

states.label: Locked (engine)
states.note: Engine lock state with hysteresis, every tick: scored time minus the time before the first lock minus the time unlocked after it.

states.label: Unlocked after the first lock (engine)
states.note: The engine's time unlocked, every tick, with hysteresis.

states.label: Lock error outside the band
states.note: 10 µs means with |lock error| > 300 pm (no hysteresis).

states.label: Heater at code 0
states.note: Register at the low rail: the heater cannot cool the ring more.

states.label: Heater at full scale
states.note: Register at the high rail: the heater cannot heat the ring more.

states.label: ADC at full scale (clipped)
states.note: Highest code in the 10 µs at 65535.

states.label: ADC over-range flag
states.note: The ADC flagged its last sample as over its range.

states.label: ADC at code 0
states.note: Lowest code in the 10 µs at 0 (no light or an under-range).

states.label: On a foreign line
states.note: Within 1 FWHM of a line that is not its declared line.

states.label: On no line
states.note: Not within 1 FWHM of any line.

states.label: Bank supply limited
states.note: The bank supply limit scaled the heater drive down.

counts.label: Lock excursions
counts.note: Locked → unlocked after the first lock (engine, every tick).

counts.label: Longest excursion (ms)
counts.note: Longest unlocked run after the first lock (engine).

counts.label: Resonance order changes
counts.note: Steps at whose end the nearest order changed (engine).

counts.label: BER windows completed
counts.note: Complete 2.0 s BER windows (engine); 0 when the run is shorter.

counts.label: Clipped heater commands
counts.note: Commands outside the code range, clipped (engine clip counter, whole run).

counts.label: ADC over-range samples
counts.note: Controller steps whose last ADC sample was flagged over-range.

limits.label: Heater code at the low rail
limits.note: Margin = code − low rail. At the rail the heater is off and cannot cool the ring further.

limits.label: Heater code at the high rail
limits.note: Margin = high rail − code. At the rail the heater cannot heat the ring further.

limits.label: Heater power at full code
limits.note: Margin = power at full code (at the present heater temperature) − power now.

limits.label: Heater driver compliance
limits.note: Margin = compliance − heater voltage. The voltage DAC full scale is below the compliance.

limits.label: Bank supply power
limits.note: Margin = supply limit − sum of the heater powers.

limits.label: Bank supply current
limits.note: Margin = supply limit − sum of the heater currents.

limits.label: ADC full scale
limits.note: Margin = full scale − the highest code (tick extreme). At full scale the code clips.

limits.label: Lock band
limits.note: Margin = band − |lock error| (tick extreme). Time at the limit: 10 µs means outside the band.

limits.label: BER limit
limits.note: Margin = log10(limit) − log10(BER): decades below the limit (BER below 1e-300 counts as 1e-300).

limits.label: Self-heating stability (loop gain 1)
limits.note: Margin = 1 − loop gain at the key frames only. At 1 the ring's own heating runs away.

limits.label: Bias DAC low end
limits.note: Margin = junction bias − bias DAC minimum.

limits.label: Bias DAC high end
limits.note: Margin = bias DAC maximum − junction bias.

junction.note: median over the key frames: the junction voltage of NRZ level 0 and level 1 (Truth), and the exact resonance of level 1 minus that of level 0 (phase model, exact ring)

note: statistics over 10 µs samples (one per controller step): window means of the engine's records (every 1 µs tick) and the kernel state read at each controller edge ('device'). min / max of the detuning, the lock error and the ADC code are tick extremes (min / max reducers). The rms and the percentiles are of the 10 µs values. 'scored': from the scoring start; '_pooled': all rings (or lines) together. Times are in ms.
